identifiability.proof: For an Omega=strain=0 calibration setting, heat=(Ta−Tb)*sum_i b/[k_i*tau^2+(gamma+b)*tau+1+b/gamma]. At tau=.2 and positive known Ta−Tb=.6, every derivative is strictly positive because b/gamma^2−tau>=b/1.1^2−.2>0. Hence this included setting alone globally identifies gamma. Other settings enrich the fit.

continuous_stability.proof: P−I/1000 and −A^T P−P A−I/1000 have exact positive rational LDL pivots at every vertex. A is affine in all six independent controls. Each interior matrix is their convex combination, so P>0 and A^T P+P A<0 throughout the complete box. Temperatures do not enter A.
